replies.author: imryaan
replies.body:
Probably one of your best maps but I can see it easily being stalemated due to just having one straight island. To prevent stalemating I would suggest making a tunnel so it's easier for rushers. Add more detail to the islands as they look boring and plain.

Good luck with your map.
